scripts.test:db: npm run --silent test:db:sql && npm run --silent test:db:e2e
scripts.test:db:sql: for f in supabase/tests/*.sql; do echo "→ $f"; psql "${LOCAL_DATABASE_URL:-postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:54322/postgres}" -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -f "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.test:db:e2e: for f in supabase/tests/*.e2e.ts; do echo "→ $f"; npx --yes deno@2 run -A "$f" || exit 1; done
